description: Add Instagram Graph API as primary polling method with scraping as fallback, token expiry warning, and updated status display.
steps: Add Graph API fetch function to instagramMonitor.js as the primary method tried before scraping
Update fetchLatestPost to try Graph API first when IG_USER_ID and IG_ACCESS_TOKEN are set
Add token expiry warning with 24h debounce using lastExpiryWarningSent state field
Update getIgStatus() to show Graph API configuration and last successful method
Update commandHandler.js !ig status to show Graph API method info and token expiry
acceptance_criteria: fetchLatestPost tries Graph API first when IG_USER_ID and IG_ACCESS_TOKEN are set
Graph API errors (401/190, 429) are handled gracefully with appropriate logging
Token expiry warning sent to owner once per 24 hours when within 7 days of expiry
getIgStatus() reports whether Graph API is configured, token expiry date, and last method used
!ig status shows method info and token expiry
